coverage.browser: Current presentation modules are scanned for simulation-world types, resolved inputs, effect queues, and direct client transition authority.
coverage.dto: Read-only host envelopes expose actor-visible projections rather than simulation-world state or resolved inputs.
coverage.read_only: History, replay, checkpoint, campaign, and regional-world tests preserve a non-mutating browser boundary.

authority_boundary: The host/core may retain true state internally; the browser consumes actor-visible projections and cannot enter transitions, resolved inputs, effect queues, or simulation authority.
limits: This closes an automated source-checkout boundary only.
It does not establish that all narrative, visual, audio, clinical, institutional, provenance, accessibility, educational, or public-release content is acceptable.
Human content, policy, provenance, and release review remain open.
